correctness.rationale: Every pair remains uncollected exactly when it covers all omitted edges, so completion is equivalent to minimum vertex cover at least three. An explicit two-state constrained vertex-cover recursion for the ideal fresh-label tree gives shifted NegBin(2,1/2). A union bound over label-reuse hazards until ideal absorption yields TV at most 17/(n-2). A uniform four-step forced path gives exponentially decaying tails and expectation convergence. A restricted-growth count proves the finite exact P(T=5) polynomial. Included standalone exact enumeration confirms rather than replaces the universal reasoning.

value.rationale: The original 2023 Markovian super-coupon collector problem motivates understanding the adjacent-subset walk. Its unexplored dense regime r=n-2, s=2 has a qualitatively different O(1) cover time and a complete shifted-negative-binomial limit with quantitative total-variation error, a uniform-integrability argument and an exact finite-n earliest-completion probability. The vertex-cover/edge-exploration reduction is a structural route to further dense-regime analysis, not a routine iid coupon count.
